name: Introduce DRY and SDK compliance certification into the expedition lifecycle
goal: Add a compliance check to the expedition lifecycle that statically inspects an expedition's deliverables for DRY violations and SDK-state-mutation misuse, and emits a machine-readable certification attached as expedition evidence. The certification is either CERTIFIED (full DRY + SDK evidence) or NOT_REQ (explicit, valid reasons the checks do not apply, e.g. no source deliverables or only derived/doc files). The check must run non-mutating: it adds NO extra lifecycle events beyond the evidence attachment.
